messages:
maria: Quick PSA — planning an opt-in 'version cascade' behavior for v2 -> v1 for a 2-week canary. Need dashboard offramps + telemetry so SRE/product can shut it down fast if errors crop up.
kevin: by 'cascade' you mean automatic downgrades when v2 times out?
maria: yes. Route precedence: primary=v2, fallback=v1. But we want a console-level kill switch + per-tenant offramps. Also avoid silent quota double-counting.
ashley: telemetry ask: we need per-client seq_len distribution + p95 latency per model variant. Otherwise we won't see perf regressions early.
samir: routing config idea:
```
routing:
  - id: default
    prefer: v2
    fallback: v1
    weights:
      v2: 90
      v1: 10
    offramps:
      error_rate: 0.005
      drift_pct: 3
```
jen: console UX: surface 'version drift' heatmap per workspace, and a 1-click 'offramp' that flips the tenant to pinned=v1 for 10m. Also show estimated cost delta.
deploy-bot: [canary] v2-cascade-rollout started for cohort=beta-50 — 200 req/s
kevin: quota/billing note: v2 token cost != v1. We need meter weights per variant and show projected billing impact when you opt-in.
ashley: propose alerting rule: when (drift_pct > 3% and error_rate > 0.5%) OR (p95_v2 > p95_v1 + 50ms) -> amber offramps. Add sample traces + quick link to failing prompts.
maria: agree. Add new metrics: `redwood.version_switch_rate`, `redwood.variant_cost_weight`, `redwood.per_tenant_seqlen_hist`.
samir: sampling plan: 0.1% full-span traces, 5% low-overhead headers. We can compute drift from sampled headers only.
jen: UX note: show 'safe revert' suggestion with rollback reason (errors/cost/latency) and estimated savings/loss.
maria: owners? platform-routing to implement config and signals; telemetry to add metrics & dashboard; console to wire offramps + cost impact.
kevin: I'll take quota mapping; jen can we get a mock for the offramps panel by Friday?
jen: yes — I'll drop a mock in #product-design by EOD Thursday :thumbsup:
ashley: I'll send a short eval prompt set to exercise edge seqlens.
maria: thanks. If anyone wants to opt into private canary early DM me. We'll keep rollout conservative. :eyes:
ops-bot: Reminder: add feature flag `v2_cascade_opt_in` to feature-flag service.
samir: PR checklist I'll open: schema, routing evaluator unit tests, e2e canary harness.
kevin: Optional: consider billing preview in console before opt-in, not just after.
maria: yes, billing preview is a must. Good catch.
jen: I'll add a 'preview changes' modal too.
maria: ok — recap: platform-routing owner=samir, telemetry owner=ashley, console owner=jen, billing=kevin. Target small canary next week. Thanks all. :party:
